comment: The Legends' Monopoly Cup - Round One. ~5 min. Numbers spelled out for TTS. Real WC2026 Round 1 results stated as fact (real-results rule satisfied). Free-to-play CTA, no prizes.
comment_timing: at = target scene start (computed from the real 296.5s clip timeline). The audio builder packs lines sequentially using these as minimums so VO never describes a scene before it appears.

lines.text: Four kings. One board.
The first round of the World Cup is over... and the dice have already been cast.
But there are no real dice here. On this board, your football rolls for you.
The rules are simple. And merciless.
Score a goal, and you buy a property.
Set up a goal for a teammate, and your token moves forward.
But do nothing... and you stay in jail.
Lionel Messi moved first.
Three goals against Algeria. A perfect hat-trick.
Three goals... three properties. He does not celebrate. He simply owns it.
A full set, in sky blue and white. Messi is top of the board.
Then came Kylian Mbappe. The fastest token in the game.
Two goals against Senegal. Two more properties claimed.
And one golden card. France's all-time leading scorer. Fifty-eight goals.
He flips it, and surges up the table, right behind Messi.
Erling Haaland does not run. He builds.
Two goals against Iraq. Two houses, slammed down like concrete.
Brick by brick, the wall climbs.
And then... there is the man in the corner.
Cristiano Ronaldo. A one to one draw. No goal. No assist.
The rules do not care about your name. Nothing earned... means jail.
He grips the bars of a board he cannot move on.
He rolls for the double that sets him free... and it slips away.
But look at his eyes. This is not the end of his story. It is the beginning of his comeback.
So this is the board after round one.
Messi's empire leads. Mbappe and Haaland are climbing fast.
And the greatest goalscorer of them all... waits in jail.
The banker gathers the cards. The dice rise again.
Round one built the empires. Round two can burn them down.
And the man behind bars has the most to prove.
You don't have to watch the kings play. You can play their game.
Go to worldcup twenty-six dot world. Pick your three teams, and collect the legends.
Hundreds of legends, and rare collectible cards, are waiting for you. Free to play, just for fun. No prizes... only glory.
Climb the board. Collect every legend. The next round... kicks off now.
